attributes.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Go + Next.JS + React Native)
attributes.description:
• 5+ years of full-stack experience; strong in Go (or deep TypeScript experience and proven ability to pick up Go fast).
  • Solid React/Next.js; React Native experience is a major plus.
  • Comfortable with webhook-driven / telephony / event-based systems — you've debugged async flows across service boundaries.
  • Able to read and navigate a large, unfamiliar codebase independently.
  • Strong SQL and comfort operating PostgreSQL in production.
  • English C1+ written and spoken.
  • Based in Latin America with at least 6 hours of overlap with US Pacific time.
attributes.projects:
California Injury Group, APC (CIG Law) is a growing personal injury law firm in Los Angeles. We built our own all-in-one practice platform in-house — CRM and case management, a complete VoIP phone system (web softphone + iOS and Android apps), SMS/MMS, fax, email pipelines, e-signature, trust accounting, and AI-powered document processing. The entire firm runs on it every day.

You'll be our first full-time engineer, working directly with the firm's owner — no PM layer, no ticket bureaucracy. The product has real daily users (our staff) who report bugs and request features constantly, so your work ships fast and gets used immediately.

The stack: Go backend (REST API, PostgreSQL, Redis, webhook-driven telephony), Next.js/React/TypeScript web, React Native (Expo) with CallKit and VoIP push, Telnyx Call Control/WebRTC/SMS/fax, Microsoft 365 integrations, LLM pipelines (Anthropic), Linux/PM2/Caddy/S3 infrastructure.
attributes.functions:
• Fix bugs at the root cause: triage reports from live users, trace them through the full stack, and fix the underlying problem — not the symptom.
  • Harden reliability: improve test coverage, observability, and error handling across a system built at high velocity.
  • Ship features: case-opening automation, workflow tooling, telephony improvements, AI-assisted document workflows.
  • Own production: deploys, database migrations, and occasional on-call for critical issues.
attributes.benefits:

attributes.desirable:

  • Expo native modules / config plugins.
  • Experience building LLM-powered features.
  • Legal, medical, or insurance domain exposure.

attributes.title: Senior Full-Stack Developer
attributes.description:
• English — required: professional working proficiency in spoken and written English. You must be comfortable participating actively in meetings, discussing technical decisions, collaborating through written channels, and understanding technical documentation.
  • Experience: at least 5 years of proven experience as a Fullstack Developer, with the autonomy to own deliverables and make technical decisions.
  • Frontend: strong command of HTML, CSS, modern JavaScript (ES6+), and solid experience with Angular.
  • Backend: solid experience with Java and Spring Boot.
  • Data and APIs: experience with SQL and/or NoSQL databases, RESTful API design, and third-party service integrations.
  • Tools: strong Git skills and collaborative development best practices.
  • AI-assisted development: hands-on experience using Claude Code effectively, with the judgment to review, test, and improve AI-generated code.
attributes.projects: Within ADS, Arara LLC's project consulting business line, we are looking for a Senior Fullstack Developer to join a fintech project. The role will own the development and evolution of a dashboard and its backend services, working with autonomy, sound technical judgment, and a product-oriented mindset.
attributes.functions:
• Design, develop, and maintain end-to-end functionality for the product dashboard and backend.
  • Translate requirements and UI/UX designs into clear, responsive, and reusable Angular interfaces.
  • Build and maintain backend services using Java and Spring Boot.
  • Design, integrate, and document secure RESTful APIs, and manage SQL and/or NoSQL databases.
  • Implement unit and integration tests, and actively participate in code reviews.
  • Use Claude Code to explore the codebase, implement changes, debug, refactor, and document, while always validating the proposed solution.
  • Collaborate with the team on technical decisions and propose improvements to architecture, quality, and development processes.
attributes.benefits:
• 100% remote work within the Americas time zones.
  • Opportunity to contribute to a fintech project from its early stages.
  • Autonomy and direct involvement in technical decisions.
  • Collaborative and agile working environment.
  • Continuous professional development and learning opportunities.
attributes.desirable:
• Previous experience working on fintech products or financial platforms.
  • Experience building dashboards or data-intensive applications.
  • Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud environments.
  • Knowledge of application security and secure development practices.
  • Experience working in consulting, project-based, or distributed teams.

attributes.title: Full-Stack Engineer (Senior)
attributes.description:
Conocimientos Técnicos Clave

Frontend

• React avanzado.

• TypeScript.

• Manejo de estado (Redux, Context API u otros).

• Testing (Jest, Testing Library u otros).

• Diseño de arquitectura de componentes.

• Performance y optimización.

Backend / Cloud

• Arquitecturas serverless en AWS.

• Diseño de APIs REST.

• Modelamiento de datos en DynamoDB.

• Manejo de eventos y orquestación.

• Observabilidad (logs, métricas, tracing).

DevOps

• CI/CD.

• Infraestructura como código.

• Git (estrategias de branching).

• Contenedores (deseable).

Seguridad

• OWASP Top 10.

• Gestión de secretos.

• Principio de mínimo privilegio.

• Autenticación y autorización (JWT, OAuth2, etc.).

Desarrollo Asistido por Inteligencia Artificial

Manejo de herramientas de inteligencia artificial generativa orientadas al desarrollo de software (como Claude Code), aplicadas como soporte para la planificación, estructuración y construcción de soluciones. Comprensión técnica plena del código y las soluciones generadas, sin recurrir a prácticas de generación de código sin supervisión ni entendimiento ('vibe coding').
attributes.projects: Profesional de alto nivel responsable de diseñar, desarrollar y evolucionar soluciones full stack complejas, participando activamente en decisiones de arquitectura, escalabilidad, seguridad y eficiencia operativa. Lidera técnicamente iniciativas críticas, promoviendo buenas prácticas de desarrollo, automatización, observabilidad y calidad de software. Diseña arquitecturas basadas en eventos, optimiza servicios cloud y contribuye a la evolución tecnológica de la organización mediante la evaluación e incorporación de nuevas tecnologías. Actúa como referente técnico para otros desarrolladores, apoyando revisiones de código y resolución de desafíos complejos.
attributes.functions:
Desarrollo Frontend

  • Desarrollar interfaces en React y TypeScript.
  • Construir componentes reutilizables y escalables.
  • Integrar aplicaciones con APIs REST.
  • Garantizar rendimiento, accesibilidad y experiencia de usuario.
  • Implementar pruebas unitarias e integración.

Desarrollo Backend Serverless

  • Desarrollar servicios backend sobre AWS Serverless.
  • Implementar lógica de negocio escalable y desacoplada.
  • Diseñar e integrar APIs REST.
  • Gestionar eventos y procesos asincrónicos.

Integración y Calidad

  • Participar en revisiones de código y mejora continua.
  • Aplicar estándares y buenas prácticas de desarrollo.
  • Implementar pruebas automatizadas.
  • Apoyar la resolución de incidentes y optimización de aplicaciones.

DevOps & CI/CD

  • Colaborar en procesos de integración y despliegue continuo.
  • Automatizar despliegues y gestión de versiones.
  • Aplicar buenas prácticas de control de código fuente.

Seguridad

  • Incorporar principios de desarrollo seguro.
  • Gestionar autenticación, autorización y protección de datos.
  • Implementar controles y validaciones de seguridad.
  • Cumplir estándares de seguridad del sector fintech.

Desarrollo Asistido por Inteligencia Artificial

  • Utilizar herramientas de IA como apoyo al desarrollo de software.
  • Validar y comprender las soluciones generadas por IA.
  • Mantener autonomía operativa ante incidencias y resolución de problemas.
  • Asegurar la calidad y responsabilidad de los entregables desarrollados.

Experiencia

attributes.description: Desarrollo de software: Auténtico entendimiento y habilitación de la innovación tecnológica
attributes.long_description:
Dynamic Devs: habilitamos procesos de innovación apoyados en la tecnología

🚀 ¿Por qué lo hacemos?

  • Nos motiva posibilitar cambios de impacto real en la vida de las personas que ayudamos.
  • Nos divierte ver que las cosas estén funcionando mejor y superarnos en el proceso.
  • Nos motiva lograr los resultados y ayudar a las personas a cumplir sus objetivos.
Más que proveedores, somos habilitadores de la tecnología y sus beneficios

✨¿Cómo lo hacemos?

Facilitamos el acceso a la tecnología para generar entendimiento y soluciones para las personas. Profundizamos y nos involucramos en las problemáticas de negocio de nuestros clientes para la optimización de sus procesos y el desarrollo de oportunidades. Nuestro principal activo es el conocimiento directo de los involucrados y sus desafíos, para crear soluciones de impacto.

Una de las principales problemáticas que encontramos en las empresas es la comunicación entre los stakeholders y la toma decisiones, por eso, más allá de proveer herramientas y conocimientos tecnológicos, nos preocupamos por gestionar el cambio, además de fortalecer lazos y comunicaciones a través de historias relevantes que generen confianza en la tecnología y que faciliten la toma de decisiones, para que los cambios puedan ocurrir.

👩‍💻 ¿Qué hacemos?

El pilar de nuestros servicios es el desarrollo de software, centrado en las mejores prácticas de DevOps, Continuous Delivery y Continuous Integration. Habilitamos procesos de innovación apoyados en la tecnología para la gestión de productos digitales y procesos empresariales.

Service Offering de Dynamic Devs

Te invitamos a unirte a nuestro equipo y desarrollar tu carrera en las siguientes áreas:

Accelerator Approach

  • Tech Accelerator Team
  • Habilitación DevOps

Build & Integrate

  • Software Development
  • Design As A Service (UX/UI)
  • Tech Talent As A Service
  • Interview As A Service

Make It Live

  • Cloud Engineering
  • Automation Engineering
  • Quality Engineering

Dynamic Culture

  • Gestión del cambio
  • Academy & Learning
  • People

¡También tenemos un podcast! Allí conversamos con referentes del sector tecnológicos, además de compartir experiencias y conocimientos a partir de los proyectos que abordamos.

¡Únete a nuestro equipo! Te estamos esperando.

attributes.description: Somos una consultora de TI con personal experto en diferentes áreas de tecnología.
attributes.long_description:
Somos una consultora de Servicios IT. Administramos portafolio, desarrollamos proyectos, realizamos outsourcing y selección de profesionales.

Creamos equipos de trabajos ágiles para áreas de Infraestructura Tecnología, Desarrollo de Software y Unidades de Negocio, en clientes de servicios financieros, seguros, retail y gobierno.

Desde hace 6 años diseñamos soluciones acorde a las necesidades de nuestros clientes. Nuestras principales áreas de negocio son:

- Consultoría y diseño de soluciones.
- Formación de equipos de trabajo, outsourcing de personal.
- Desarrollo de proyectos.
- Servicios de soporte y administración IT

Tenemos un enfoque claro en el cliente, metodologías ágiles, cambio organizacional y desarrollo de productos.
attributes.projects: En BC Tecnología gestionamos portafolios, desarrollamos proyectos y ofrecemos servicios de outsourcing y selección de profesionales para clientes de sectores como servicios financieros, seguros, retail y gobierno. Participarás en iniciativas estratégicas de transformación digital para LATAM Airlines, una organización líder en la industria aeronáutica, en un entorno que combina trabajo remoto con presencia ocasional en oficina. attributes.description:
As a small, growing marketing technology startup, our codebase has many facets, ranging from performance-optimized code to API integrations, web crawling and UI development. No two days will be the same, and you will be required to wear many hats.

The ideal candidate will:

  • Be a senior, product-minded Rails generalist — you understand that the why of what we build supersedes the how. You care about user experience, business impact, and pragmatic engineering.
  • Possess the maturity and independence needed to personally own and ship production-ready features. Your thoroughly self-tested code will account for edge cases, fit smoothly into our existing application UI/UX, and rarely require senior refactoring / oversight before release.
  • Align with the "Rails is omakase" philosophy. You bring a strong command of Ruby / Rails, web architecture, and convention over configuration, preferring to leverage built-in framework patterns and existing UI systems to deliver high-value features quickly and efficiently.
  • Demonstrate strong codebase stewardship by instinctively recognizing technical debt, simplifying complex code, and refactoring existing patterns as part of your day-to-day workflow.
  • Showcase skill in steering agentic coding tools to navigate codebases and execute tasks, focusing your expertise on architecture, context curation, and rigorous code review. You actively refine agent directive files and custom workflows to maximize output quality.
  • Communicate clearly and effectively in fluent, near-native English, with proven experience collaborating asynchronously across cross-functional teams in a North American startup environment.
  • Relish the wide variety of technical and product challenges facing our small team, bringing the broad skillset, curiosity, and adaptability we value to craft creative solutions.
attributes.projects:
Kutoku is a content-driven affiliate network. We help 600+ global partners scale their businesses with our state-of-the-art affiliate technology.

Founded in 2016, Kutoku's mission is to empower content creators and high-quality brands to work together to build lasting relationships which support each others' growth. Kutoku partners only with genuine content publishers and avoids coupon, cashback, and loyalty program websites and tools.

We are seeking a senior, full stack, product-minded web developer to work closely with our CTO as we continue to develop our world class affiliate platform.

Kutoku is a fully-remote company based in Canada.
attributes.functions:
Our applications are architected using Ruby on Rails (Turbo/Hotwire/Stimulus/Minitest), Postgres, Redis and are deployed on Google Cloud.

Your work will be varied and range from small UI bugfixes through to complex feature/application development. You will interact with the founders daily and will be comfortable working both independently and collaboratively.

In this role, you will work across our entire stack to build and refine:

  • Affiliate tracking, conversion attribution, and flexible commissioning systems that power offers, referrals, and partner earnings.
  • Dynamic reporting dashboards, performance charts, and data tables that give partners actionable insights.
  • Mission-critical financial systems including subscription billing, invoicing, payment reconciliation, and automated payouts, where precision and data integrity are vital.
  • Reliable integrations, webhooks, and background data pipelines connecting Kutoku with ecommerce, payment, and partner platforms.
  • External REST APIs and clear developer documentation.
  • Product and partner directories with comprehensive search and filtering.
  • Partner signup, onboarding, account security, and role-based access flows.
  • Our custom Shopify application, affiliate-link tooling, and browser extensions.
  • Content ingestion and brand-mention monitoring across publisher websites and channels.
  • Internal administrative tools, operational reports, and custom applications.
  • Root-cause analysis, triage, and resolution of production errors and data-integrity issues.

attributes.title: Senior Forward Deployed AI Engineer (Anthropic)
attributes.description:
Required Experience

  • 3–5 years of experience in software engineering or data engineering, with extensive hands-on use of AI tools and LLM-based development over the past year (professional projects, internal initiatives, or substantial personal builds).
  • Professional English proficiency (C1/C2 minimum) — mandatory. You will work daily with international clients and colleagues.
  • Strong hands-on experience with the Anthropic ecosystem: Claude API, Claude Agent SDK or Claude Code, and MCP — ideally with experience taking at least one solution to production.
  • Strong programming skills in Python and TypeScript/JavaScript, and experience building and consuming APIs.
  • Experience with front-end development (React or similar) and at least one backend framework.
  • Hands-on experience with RAG, embeddings, and vector search, and with at least one agentic framework (Claude Agent SDK, LangGraph/LangChain).
  • Working experience with at least one cloud platform (GCP, AWS, or Azure); running Claude via Vertex AI or Amazon Bedrock is a plus.
  • Fluency with agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, or Cursor.
  • Experience building and maintaining data pipelines.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Certifications

An Anthropic certification is a strong differentiator at application. If you do not hold one yet, obtaining it within your first 2 months in the role is a requirement — as a member of our team, Artefact will sponsor your exam and give you time to prepare.

  • Claude Certified Developer – Foundations (Anthropic Certification Program), or a higher-level Claude Certified Architect credential.
  • Anthropic Academy completion certificates (Claude API, MCP, Claude Code) are valued as supporting evidence.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience with MCP servers, multi-agent patterns, or LLM evaluation tooling (LangSmith, Langfuse, promptfoo).
  • Experience with Terraform or CI/CD pipelines.
  • Contributions to the MCP ecosystem, published MCP servers, or open-source agentic tooling.

Key Capabilities

A strong candidate will bring:

  • Deep expertise in the Anthropic platform, combined with breadth across the full stack
  • Owns features end to end, from interface to infrastructure
  • Cares about evaluation and reliability, not just the happy path
  • Communicates clearly with clients in demos, documents, and code review
  • Client-facing mindset: understands client needs and translates business requirements into technical solutions
  • Learns new tools and models fast, and shares what works
attributes.projects:
Artefact is a next-generation data and AI consulting firm dedicated to accelerating the adoption of data and AI to create measurable business impact across the full enterprise value chain.

We sit at the intersection of consulting, data science, AI technologies, data engineering, and digital transformation. We do not just advise — we build, implement, and deliver results our clients can measure. Our teams bring together consultants, data scientists, data engineers, AI engineers, analysts, and digital experts to solve complex business challenges with pragmatic, production-ready solutions.

As Artefact continues to grow globally, we are building a team of entrepreneurial data and AI talent who can help clients move beyond experimentation and into scalable, governed, value-generating AI adoption.
attributes.functions:
Our team is looking for Senior Deployed AI Engineers specialized in the Anthropic (Claude) ecosystem: embedded with clients, taking AI products from idea to production.

In this role, you'll design and build the interfaces, services, and agentic systems at the heart of our work: conversational apps, agents automating workflows, and the pipelines supporting them. You own components end to end: front end, service, data, deployment, evals.

Build Full-Stack AI Applications, End to End

  • Develop interfaces in TypeScript/React and backend services/APIs in Python or Node.
  • Implement agentic behavior: orchestration, tool/function calling, memory, guardrails.
  • Build RAG pipelines: ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector/hybrid search.
  • Connect AI systems to enterprise data via APIs, semantic layers, and MCP.

Go Deep on the Anthropic Platform

  • Build agentic systems with the Claude API and Agent SDK: tool use, extended thinking, prompt caching, citations.
  • Deploy cloud-hosted agents with Claude Managed Agents: sandboxed execution, memory, checkpointing, orchestration, tracing.
  • Build MCP servers/clients connecting Claude to enterprise systems.
  • Make Claude Code core to delivery — skills, subagents, hooks.
  • Deploy Claude via the API, Vertex AI, or Bedrock, choosing Opus/Sonnet/Haiku per trade-off.
  • Track Anthropic's releases and translate capabilities into value.

Make AI Systems Production-Grade

  • Write evals and regression tests; monitor cost, latency, quality.
  • Apply solid practice: version control, review, testing, CI/CD, observability.
  • Deploy on GCP/Azure/AWS using containers, serverless, infra-as-code.
  • Build and maintain data pipelines feeding AI systems.

Work AI-Natively and Client-Facing

  • Use agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, Cursor) daily, with good judgment.
  • Communicate progress, trade-offs, and blockers to clients and leads.
  • Support pre-sales: scope solutions, build demos, estimate effort.
  • Mentor engineers; contribute to accelerators and standards.
attributes.benefits:
At Artefact, data and AI are not abstract strategy topics. They are tools for creating business value, improving organizations, and helping people make better decisions.
You will join a global community of data and AI experts who combine consulting, engineering, data science, marketing, and technology expertise. You will work on complex, high-impact problems with leading organizations and help shape how enterprises adopt AI responsibly and effectively.

attributes.title: Desarrollador Full-Stack
attributes.description:
Formación universitaria en Ingeniería Civil en Computación / Informática o carrera afín.
CONOCIMIENTOS ESPECÍFICOS REQUERIDOS
Idiomas: Inglés técnico deseable
Arquitectura y desarrollo: Desarrollo experto en Node.js, aplicación de arquitectura hexagonal, principios SOLID, patrones de diseño de software y diseño de sistemas distribuidos.
Arquitectura Cloud e Infraestructura: Experiencia en construcción de servicios cloud (AWS/Azure), escalabilidad, resiliencia y observabilidad de aplicaciones.
Arquitectura de Software (Hexagonal): Implementación técnica de arquitectura orientada a eventos (EDA), uso de brokers de mensajería y patrones de integración.
Desarrollo agéntico: Agentes de IA, skills, MCP, context engineering, prompting y evals; uso de asistentes de código para el ciclo de desarrollo. Experiencia en plataformas como Claude Code, Codex u Open Code para desarrollo agéntico.
CI/CD y repositorios: GitHub y GitHub Actions, estrategia de ramas unificada, automatización de pipelines.
Calidad y seguridad: Secure SDLC, OWASP, análisis de vulnerabilidades y deuda técnica (Snyk, SonarQube), evidencia automatizada y normativa ISO 27001.
Frontend: UI Kit corporativo CCS (HTML + JS + Tailwind); interfaces responsivas y accesibles.
Plataformas corporativas: Nubes: Azure/AWS. Odoo (en migración), ERP Oracle, Google Workspace + Gemini, Power BI / Data Warehouse y ecosistema cloud.
attributes.projects: Objetivos del cargo (Misión): Liderar la implementación, desarrollo y entrega de soluciones de software de alta calidad, asegurando la mantenibilidad, escalabilidad y buenas prácticas en el código, bajo la estrategia técnica de la compañía. Asegura la construcción de software verificado, seguro y de alto rendimiento, manteniendo la excelencia técnica en la ejecución y contribuyendo a la creación de valor mediante el desarrollo de ecosistemas digitales robustos.
attributes.functions:
Desarrollar componentes y soluciones de software aplicando arquitectura hexagonal (Ports & Adapters) para garantizar el desacoplamiento técnico. Implementar principios SOLID y patrones de diseño avanzado en Node.js para asegurar un código mantenible y extensible. Construir y desplegar servicios escalables y resilientes en infraestructura cloud (AWS/Azure). Implementar soluciones basadas en eventos (event-driven architecture) y microservicios, asegurando la integración eficiente con servicios core. Resguardar la calidad técnica a lo largo de todo el ciclo: revisar, validar y autorizar el diseño de la solución y los cambios antes de su integración y puesta en producción, garantizando pruebas, seguridad, documentación y trazabilidad.
Definir la estrategia técnica para la entrega híbrida entre agentes de IA, equipos internos y proveedores, estableciendo lineamientos y criterios de aceptación. Gobernar el uso de agentes en su flujo de valor: aplicar mínimo privilegio, vetting de skills/MCPs y un nivel de autonomía proporcional al riesgo de cada cambio. Construir y curar el contexto y la documentación como código de su dominio (reglas de negocio, glosario, skills, plantillas), alimentando el repositorio técnico institucional.
Asegurar seguridad y calidad por diseño y pipelines como autoridad de evidencia para auditoría (ISO 27001). Aplicar los estándares, principios y arquitecturas de referencia definidos por la Subgerencia de Arquitectura TI, escalando oportunamente las desviaciones. Supervisar el cumplimiento de estándares técnicos y calidad de arquitectura por parte de proveedores y partners. Liderar la adopción de prácticas de ingeniería y arquitectura, actuando como mentor técnico en el uso de estándares y nuevas tecnologías. Definir métricas de salud de sistema y deuda técnica para monitorear la calidad evolutiva de las soluciones.

- Formación de equipos de trabajo, outsourcing de personal.

attributes.name: BC Tecnología
attributes.description: Somos una consultora de TI con personal experto en diferentes áreas de tecnología.
attributes.long_description:
Somos una consultora de Servicios IT. Administramos portafolio, desarrollamos proyectos, realizamos outsourcing y selección de profesionales.

Creamos equipos de trabajos ágiles para áreas de Infraestructura Tecnología, Desarrollo de Software y Unidades de Negocio, en clientes de servicios financieros, seguros, retail y gobierno.

Desde hace 6 años diseñamos soluciones acorde a las necesidades de nuestros clientes. Nuestras principales áreas de negocio son:

- Consultoría y diseño de soluciones.
- Formación de equipos de trabajo, outsourcing de personal.
- Desarrollo de proyectos.
- Servicios de soporte y administración IT

Tenemos un enfoque claro en el cliente, metodologías ágiles, cambio organizacional y desarrollo de productos.
attributes.projects: En BC Tecnología gestionamos portafolios, desarrollamos proyectos y ofrecemos servicios de outsourcing y selección de profesionales para clientes de sectores como servicios financieros, seguros, retail y gobierno. Participarás en iniciativas estratégicas de transformación digital para LATAM Airlines, una organización líder en la industria aeronáutica, en un entorno que combina trabajo remoto con presencia ocasional en oficina. Serás parte de la Gerencia de Arquitectura, colaborando en la definición de la arquitectura empresarial y su evolución ante cambios tecnológicos y de negocio, asegurando alineación con la estrategia corporativa y con estándares de gobernanza.
attributes.benefits:
En BC Tecnología promovemos un ambiente de trabajo colaborativo que valora el compromiso y el aprendizaje constante. Nuestra cultura se orienta al crecimiento profesional a través de la integración y el intercambio de conocimientos entre equipos.
La modalidad híbrida que ofrecemos, ubicada en Las Condes, permite combinar la flexibilidad del trabajo remoto con la colaboración presencial, facilitando un mejor equilibrio y dinamismo laboral.
Participarás en proyectos innovadores con clientes de alto nivel y sectores diversos, en un entorno que fomenta la inclusión, el respeto y el desarrollo técnico y profesional.

attributes.title: Senior Full-Stack Software Developer
attributes.description:
• 10+ years of professional software development experience
  • Expert-level backend development experience
  • Extensive professional experience with PHP
  • Strong experience with Symfony or comparable enterprise PHP frameworks
  • Proven experience designing the architecture of complex production applications
  • Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, design patterns, and software architecture
  • Advanced SQL and relational database experience
  • Experience designing, building, documenting, and maintaining RESTful APIs
  • Strong understanding of application security, performance, scalability, and reliability
  • Experience debugging difficult issues across large, interconnected systems
  • Solid professional experience with JavaScript and TypeScript
  • Working knowledge of React and Next.js
  • Experience with Git, code reviews, testing, deployment, and modern development workflows
  • Experience successfully taking ownership of major projects from planning through production
  • Ability to evaluate an existing system and improve it without unnecessarily rebuilding everything
  • A consistent history of delivering stable, maintainable, production-quality software

This position requires strong conversational English.

You do not need to speak perfect English, but you must be able to communicate clearly and efficiently during live video calls with our US-based leadership and engineering teams. You must be comfortable discussing technical problems, asking questions, explaining your decisions, providing updates, and raising concerns before they become larger issues.

Written communication alone is not sufficient for this role.

  • You are a genuinely senior engineer who can solve difficult problems independently
  • Backend architecture and complex business logic are among your strongest skills
  • You can examine unfamiliar code, understand it quickly, and make responsible improvements
  • You think beyond whether the code works and consider security, scalability, maintainability, and business impact
  • You communicate proactively and do not disappear when a problem becomes difficult
  • You ask thoughtful questions before making major technical decisions
  • You accept feedback professionally and can respectfully challenge ideas when you see a better solution
  • You deliver what you commit to and communicate early when priorities or timelines need to change
  • You are comfortable being accountable for important production systems
  • You maintain a high standard for your own work without requiring constant supervision
  • Delivering reliable, production-quality software that solves meaningful business problems
  • Becoming a trusted technical leader within the engineering team
  • Improving the stability, performance, security, and scalability of our platform
  • Making our existing codebase easier and safer to maintain
  • Reducing technical debt while continuing to deliver valuable new products
  • Helping other developers make better technical decisions
  • Communicating clearly with both technical and non-technical leadership
  • Taking ownership of challenging projects and carrying them through completion
attributes.projects:
One Click Technology is a U.S.-based software and digital marketing company serving the factory-built housing industry. We operate ManufacturedHomes.com, ModularHomes.com, hundreds of client websites, a custom CMS and CRM, AI tools, search technology, and internal business systems.

Our vision is to modernize how factory-built homes are marketed, discovered, financed, and sold. Our biggest challenge is modernizing established systems while building scalable new products using AI, automation, and better data.

You will join a small, experienced remote engineering team and work closely with company leadership. We promote ownership, accountability, independent thinking, direct communication, and continuous improvement. Your work will directly support platforms used by home manufacturers, retailers, lenders, and consumers across the United States.
attributes.functions:
• Design, build, and maintain complex backend systems using PHP and Symfony
  • Make sound architectural decisions that support scalability, reliability, security, and long-term maintainability
  • Develop APIs, integrations, background processes, automation workflows, and complex business logic
  • Work within a large existing codebase and quickly understand how interconnected systems operate
  • Modernize legacy applications without disrupting critical business operations
  • Diagnose and resolve difficult performance, data, infrastructure, and application issues
  • Design and optimize relational databases, queries, and data structures
  • Integrate third-party platforms, APIs, AI models, and automation tools
  • Contribute to frontend applications built with React, Next.js, JavaScript, and TypeScript
  • Take ownership of projects from technical planning through deployment and ongoing support
  • Review code and help establish strong engineering standards
  • Mentor other developers and provide technical leadership when needed
  • Collaborate directly with leadership, product stakeholders, and other engineers
  • Clearly explain technical problems, recommendations, timelines, and tradeoffs
attributes.desirable:
• AWS or other cloud infrastructure experience
  • Experience integrating AI models or LLMs into production applications
  • Experience with custom CMS or CRM platforms
  • Experience modernizing large legacy systems
  • CI/CD pipeline and production deployment experience
  • Docker and containerized development environments
  • Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, or other search technologies
  • Background jobs, queues, caching, and event-driven systems
  • Automated testing and quality assurance practices
  • Experience leading technical projects or mentoring engineers
  • Experience working on a small, senior team where individual ownership matters
